description: The chart illustrates the accuracy of different models on the PHEME dataset, comparing their performance across various configurations. The horizontal axis contains categories labeled "Ours", "w/o comments", "w/o text", "w/o select", "w/o emotion", and "w/o cognition", while the vertical axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)" and ranges from 75.0 to 92.5 in increments of 2.5. The bars are grouped into two sets, with the first set representing the PHEME dataset and the second set representing an unspecified dataset labeled "Pheme" and "P***" respectively, although the latter is partially cut off. For the PHEME dataset, the bars are colored red for "Ours" at 89.84%, orange for "w/o comments" at 86.82%, yellow for "w/o text" at 80.10%, light blue for "w/o select" at 88.80%, blue for "w/o emotion" at 87.34%, and dark blue for "w/o cognition" at 87.17%. For the other dataset, the bars are colored similarly, with values of 90.57% for "Ours", 85.85% for "w/o comments", 83.02% for "w/o text", 89.62% for "w/o select", 84.91% for "w/o emotion", and 87.74% for "w/o cognition". The bars are not sorted in a specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
